final: WITH country_ratios AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(CAST(pav.points_won AS FLOAT) / pav.points_max) as country_avg FROM player_award_vote pav JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id WHERE pav.points_won IS NOT NULL AND pav.points_max IS NOT NULL AND pav.points_max > 0 GROUP BY p.death_country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg) as overall_avg FROM country_ratios) SELECT cr.death_country, cr.country_avg, CASE WHEN oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL THEN cr.country_avg / oa.overall_avg ELSE NULL END as ratio_to_overall FROM country_ratios cr CROSS JOIN overall oa WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cr.death_country
